name: web-photographer-card-with-blue-geometric-tile-artwork-on-navy
title: Cornflower card on navy with a centred name, short bio, See more link and rounded artwork of white and indigo circle and square tiles
whatItIs: A deep navy page with a cornflower blue rounded card holding a white centred name 'Matthias Leidinger', a short paragraph, an underlined 'See more' with an arrow at the left and, at the right, a rounded image of Bauhaus-like tiles of white and dark indigo circles, quarter circles and squares on a bright blue ground.
whatItMeans: Modern and playful; geometric tile art gives a simple profile card an art-gallery feel.
techniques: Set artwork from simple circles and squares.
Use a single blue family on navy.
Pair text left with a rounded image right.

vocabulary.definition: Compositions from circles, arcs and squares.
An underlined link with an arrow.
Several shades of blue used together.
